F01_before_wal_write.behavior: 0 bytes written on crash; client retry with original key produces 202 accepted_durable and 1 history observation (245.6)

F02_partial_tail_frame_before_sync.behavior: Recovery detects trailing incomplete frame, truncates segment to exact offset of last durable record, preserves prior durable records, and accepts client retry for tail message

F03_after_fsync_before_ack.behavior: Recovery replays synced WAL record into DB and restores dedup index; client retry with same key returns HTTP 200 duplicate with original ingest_id; conflicting payload returns HTTP 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (T04)

F04_db_commit_and_checkpoint_lag.behavior: Uncommitted DB record is replayed from WAL; already committed DB record with lagging checkpoint is skipped via applied_messages (SkippedAlreadyApplied) and checkpoint advances without duplicate rows

F05_middle_record_byte_corruption.behavior: CRC32/SHA-256 mismatch on middle record #2 halts replay immediately at record #2 offset, emits MiddleRecordCorrupted alert, sets HaltedOnWalCorruption, and refuses to silently skip to record #3

T07_hard_watermark_backpressure.behavior: Exceeding soft watermark returns 202 accepted_durable with warning WAL_SOFT_WATERMARK_EXCEEDED; exceeding hard watermark with Prefer: durability=durable returns HTTP 503 DURABILITY_BACKPRESSURE (retryable=true) and never downgrades to accepted_volatile
